full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white street photograph captures a woman's reflection in a large city window as she holds a small camera in front of her chest. She stands near the left center, dark hair falling to the shoulders and eyes looking toward the lens through the glass. A dark coat and a large bag at her side form heavy shapes in the lower half, while pale shirt or scarf fabric brightens the area around her hands. The window adds a second scene over her body: a sunlit sidewalk runs diagonally from the lower left toward the distant right, with parked cars, moving vehicles, and tall buildings overlapping the portrait. On the far left, dark vertical window framing and shadowed façades hold the edge; farther back, tiny pedestrians and street signs appear but remain too small or obscured to read. Hard midday sun enters from the upper right, creating bright pavement and strong patches of glare on the glass. The woman's face is partly in shadow, so her features are more subdued than the street reflection cutting across her coat. Several layers of transparency make it uncertain where reflection ends and the view through the window begins, yet the camera and head remain clear anchors. Fine film grain, slight blur in moving traffic, and high contrast between bright concrete and black clothing give the image a candid analog quality. The vertical window edge splits the space without turning it into separate panels. The overall composition is dense and observational, using layered reflection to fuse the photographer, passing street, and city architecture into one moment.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白街头摄影捕捉一位女子在大城市玻璃窗中的倒影，她把小相机举在胸前。她站在中央偏左，深发垂至肩，眼睛透过玻璃望向镜头。深色外套和身侧的大包在下半部形成沉重形状，浅衬衣或围巾布料则照亮双手周围。窗面把第二重场景叠在她身上：日照人行道从左下斜向右远处，停靠与行驶的车及高楼与肖像重叠。最左边，深色竖窗框和阴影立面稳住边缘；更远有极小行人与街牌，但太小或受遮挡，无法阅读。强烈正午阳光从右上进入，使路面明亮，也在玻璃上形成强眩光。女子脸部分留影，所以面部特征比横切外套的街景反射更低调。多层透明关系让反射和窗外视野的边界难以确定，但相机和头部仍是清楚支点。细胶片颗粒、移动车辆的轻微模糊、亮混凝土与黑衣之间的高反差给图像直接的胶片质感。竖窗缘分开空间，却没有把它变成不同画格。整体构图密集而观察性强，通过层叠倒影把摄影者、经过的街道与城市建筑融合成同一时刻。
style_prompt_en: The photograph uses high-contrast black-and-white street observation, with transparent reflections building several spatial layers in one frame. Bright pavement and glass glare slice through deep coats, vehicles, and dark vertical frames. Fine film grain and slight motion softness coexist with clear focal features, preserving the spontaneous nature of the scene. Strong side daylight creates irregular zones of white and black rather than evenly modeled surfaces. Overlapping silhouettes and lines compress the city into a dense pattern, while a few recognizable central shapes hold the visual story together. The overall effect is candid, urban, and optically complex.
style_prompt_zh: 照片采用高反差黑白街头观察，以透明倒影在一格里搭成数层空间。明亮铺地与玻璃眩光切过深色衣料、车辆和竖向暗框。细胶片颗粒和轻微运动柔化与清楚焦点并存，保留场景的即时性。强侧日光制造不规则黑白区域，而非均匀塑形表面。重叠剪影与线条把城市压成密集纹样，少数可辨中央形状维系视觉叙事。整体效果抓拍、城市化且光学关系复杂。
theme_en: A woman photographing her own reflection in a city shop window
theme_zh: 女子在城市橱窗中拍摄自己的倒影
name: Lee Friedlander
